name: io.github.Za0Shu1/ue-prism
title: ue-prism
description: MCP server for Unreal Engine projects: read-only diagnostics (logs / performance / asset references) plus a guarded asset-migration suite. Connects to a running editor over a local file bus with zero project-path configuration.

ue-prism.description: Connect the agent to a running Unreal Engine editor (auto-discovers active projects via the local registry).
